items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we played opposite Erskine Hawkins. He had in the Savoy Ballroom in New York... Erskine had this band and we'd come on and we were the foot stompers

ctx.x: And the only trumpet player -- well, we played oppo-

site Erskine Hawkins. He had in the Savoy Ballroom in New York, and Roy would just wipe him out every set, you know, it was just pitiful. Erskine had this band and we'd come on and we were the foot stompers, you know. But the only trumpet player that would come up with -- and jam with Roy was a guy by the name of Dizzy Gillespie. And he played different from anyone.
I noticed this harmonic sense was different -- he was harmonically different from anything I'd ever heard, you know. And he would come and jam on the stand with Roy.
